content: Ghostfolio: Account + AccountBalance[], currency on account, MarketData for FX/prices, conversion via toCurrencyAtDate — closest OSS analog for dated conversion. Firefly III: double-entry + net worth report, heavier than v1 needs. Actual Budget: SQLite local-first envelope budgeting, not NW-first. Recommend Wallet architecture closer to Ghostfolio cash-balance snapshots + dated FX tables than Firefly ledger.
